description: Source code for extending invoice and tax code functionalities in an Odoo module, including BVR payment processing and tax code case addition.

classes.name: AccountInvoice
classes.description: Extends the 'account.invoice' model to add Swiss BVR payment functionalities, reference validation, and partner bank interactions.

classes.name: AccountTaxCode
classes.description: Extends the 'account.tax.code' model to include a 'Case Code' field.

methods.name: _get_reference_type
methods.description: Adds 'bvr' to the list of reference types for invoices.

methods.name: _amount_to_pay
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount to be paid on invoices.

methods.name: _check_bvr
methods.description: Validates BVR reference numbers based on checksum.

methods.name: _check_reference_type
methods.description: Ensures reference type matches partner bank type.

methods.name: onchange_partner_bank
methods.description: Updates reference type based on selected partner bank.
